changes: Fixed installing a load balancer on a panel in API mode (the default since 2.6.2): the install no longer stops at "No xc_agent on the node" with "MySQL: Cannot connect to database", and the node starts its services once its enrolment has brought the replica.
Fixed a fresh install whose nginx refused the access-code configuration (an unfilled alias and rate-limit zone), which left every page unreachable.

Added the segment gateway, off by default: with fanout delivering, xc_fanout answers a load balancer's HLS segments, keys, catch-up minutes and known viewers' playlist refreshes instead of PHP-FPM (Settings → Cluster → Segment Gateway). It needs an xc_fanout release that includes the gateway; a node without one keeps serving through PHP.

Added the gateway's shadow mode: PHP keeps serving while the gateway judges a copy of each request, and the two answers are compared. Cluster Nodes (Segment Gateway column) and /metrics show the comparison, and a node is marked ready after 7 days without a disagreement.
A catch-up segment refused for the viewer's address no longer keeps that viewer's session alive.
No module installs by itself any more: Watch and Plex are no longer downloaded at every start, and a deleted module stays deleted.
The Modules page drops Uninstall: Delete removes a module and its data, and Disable switches it off and keeps everything.
With xcvm_core 2.4.0, the module store lists modules and installs free ones without an API key; the Store tab searches, sorts and pages.
Migrating a backup now hands module tables (such as Watch's watch folders) to their modules, which copy them when they are installed, instead of losing them without the module.
The TMDb refresh queue now belongs to the core, so TMDb refreshes and category or profile deletion work without the Watch module.
Invalid stream ids, and credentials that match no line, are now logged as client refusals, so scraping and credential guessing can be counted per address across every server.
The verification banner's button now copies the HWID and opens the page to get a key.
